$comment: Mitsubishi MC protocol (MELSEC Communication Protocol) 3E frame golden vectors. Sources: MELSEC Communication Protocol Reference Manual SH(NA)-080008-AB (2022-05); SLMP Reference Manual SH(NA)-080956ENG-M (2025-05); Q Corresponding Ethernet Interface Module User's Manual (Basic) SH(NA)-080009-X. Complete ASCII frames are the sample-program frames printed in the E71 manual. Data sections are the request/response data examples printed with the batch read/write commands, quoted from the command byte onward. Entries carrying a "$derived" note are NOT quoted frames — no manual prints a complete response frame end to end, so any full response here is assembled from the manuals' stated field rules and labelled as such. DO NOT MODIFY.

host.$comment: Host-station access route. Binary bytes are network No., PC No., I/O No. (little-endian), station No.

fieldEncoding.$comment: The manuals' own worked examples of how one value is written in each mode.

deviceNumbers.$comment: Head device No. encoding. M is written in decimal, X in hexadecimal, so the same digits mean different points.

x1234.$derived: The manual prints only the binary form for X1234; the ASCII form follows from the rule that the head device No. is written in the device's own notation, padded to 6 digits.

asciiFrames.$comment: Complete on-the-wire ASCII request frames from the E71 manual's sample program. Host station access route, CPU monitoring timer 000AH.

writeD0to4ControlCpu.$comment: Same write addressed to the control-system CPU: request destination module I/O No. 03D0H.

dataSections.$comment: Request/response data quoted from the command byte onward (no header). MELSEC-Q/L subcommands: word units 0000H, bit units 0001H.

readM100Word.$comment: M100-M131 read in word units: 32 points is 2 words.

subcommands.$comment: Word/bit unit selection. MELSEC-Q/L uses 0000H/0001H; MELSEC iQ-R uses 0002H/0003H.

pointLimits.$comment: Batch read/write point limits per access unit.

response.$comment: Response header layout. The end code is the only completion information this engine interprets: 0000H is normal completion, and the manuals redirect to the module manual for every other code, so no meaning table is shipped.

normalRead.$derived: Assembled from the documented response header layout plus the quoted response data of readTn100Word. No manual prints a complete response frame end to end.

abnormal.$derived: Assembled from the documented abnormal-completion layout: end code followed by error information (access route 5 bytes, command 2, subcommand 2). The end code value is illustrative only.
